thread:
Ivy: FYI during onboarding today a couple of new users got confused by the chat response parsing examples in README. The JS and Python snippets expect `.text` but the SDK now returns a `message` object.
Ivy: Broken JS snippet (copy/paste):
```js
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
console.log(res.choices[0].text);
```
Ivy: That prints `undefined` now; new SDK returns `res.choices[0].message.content` or `res.message` depending on language binding.
Dan: Where's the file?
Ivy: docs/onboarding/response-parsing.md lines ~10-34. Python example similarly does `resp['text']` which errors.
Priya: Oof. When we changed the server response shape last quarter we updated SDK docs but missed this standalone parsing guide. New users copy the examples and then file "undefined property" tickets.
docs-bot: Snippet-linter alert: deprecated response access pattern detected in docs/onboarding/response-parsing.md -> use of `.choices[0].text` and `resp['text']`. Rule: docs-response-shape-2026.
Samir: Quick fixes: (1) update JS to `console.log(res.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || res.message?.content);`, (2) update Python to `print(resp['choices'][0]['message']['content'])` and show a safe accessor pattern, (3) add a tiny note explaining server->SDK mapping and that some SDKs normalize to `res.message` for single-choice calls.
Ivy: Also propose adding a tiny test in samples/verify-snippets.sh that runs a static grep for `.choices\[0\]\.text` and `['text']` to catch this on PRs. That would stop copy/paste drift.
Dan: Good idea. Also add a short compatibility paragraph showing migration: old -> new examples, so folks searching issues find guidance.
support: We've had 12 tickets this month referencing "cannot read property 'text' of undefined" with links to that doc. If we fix this quickly, should cut a chunk of noise.
Priya: I'll open a PR to update the page, add migration note, and add the linter rule. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1201 - updates response parsing examples for JS/Python and adds the grep rule.
docs-bot: Preview deployed for PR #1201: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-1201 - snippet-linter flagged resolved. :white_check_mark:
Ivy: Thanks team. Once that merges can support bulk-close linked tickets. Closing thread after merge. :thumbsup:
